verdict.rationale: Brex Bill Pay documents all three parts of the story. Invoice capture: Brex AI captures itemized details, suggests the matching PO and drafts a payment. Approvals: multi-level flows route automatically by amount, vendor or role. Payment: ACH, checks and wires go out from any bank account or a Brex business account, and the Payments API manages vendors and sends ACH, domestic wires and checks. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill-pay workflow; all evidence is vendor-claimed.
